title: Proteus Player Registry (v1)
description: A canonical inventory of frozen player specimens. THE REGISTRY DESCRIBES SPECIMENS; IT DOES NOT DEFINE PLAYER TYPES. There are no families, classes, tags, taxonomy or quality scores, and introducing any would be a contract violation. This document is DESCRIPTIVE: proteus.integration.registry.validate_registry is the AUTHORITY when the two disagree, and player-manifest validity is delegated to proteus.foundry.vm.validate_manifest so there is exactly one source of truth for it. A test asserts the field lists here match the code.

registry_id.description: sha256 over {schema_version, build, [entry_id...]}. Recomputed and checked on load.

source_qualification.description: What the specimens' source is and is NOT qualified for. Travels with every registry so a consumer never needs archaeological knowledge of V0.6.

build.description: How the population was produced: directive and its sha256, foundry manifest, seed, counts, and the selection rule in words.

entry.description: One specimen. INTRINSIC fields determine identity; the single OPEN namespace 'extrinsic' does not. entry_id = sha256 of the entry minus extrinsic and entry_id, so a consumer may write observations into extrinsic without altering any identity.

organism_id.description: sha256 of the canonical player manifest. The authoritative organism identity.

manifest.description: The immutable player itself, schema prometheus/proteus/player_manifest/v0.

resource_envelope.description: Hard bounds for scheduling. Never a score or ranking.

validation.description: The authoritative validator's verdict, recorded not recomputed.

extrinsic.description: THE ONE OPEN NAMESPACE. Consumer-owned observations: behaviour, encounters, phenotype, scores, novelty. Defaults to phenotype=UNKNOWN, a permanent legitimate state. Never an input to organism_id or entry_id.
